profile.name: Bénéteau S.A.
profile.summary: Bénéteau S.A. designs, produce, and sells recreational boats in France, rest of Europe, North America, South America, Asia, and internationally. It provides boats under the Beneteau, Jeanneau, Lagoon, Prestige, Four Winns, Scarab, WellCraft, EXCESS, and Delphia brand names. The company also offers Band of Boats, a community services platform for purchase and sale of boats; lease purchase, credit, insurance services, and inventory and retail finance solutions through SGB Finance; Dream Yacht Charter, offers a large fleet of boats, and a yacht brokerage consultant; Your Boat Club, an online booking system; and WIZIBOAT, a mobile app offers subscription for sailing. In addition, it engages in yacht equipment, decoration, and customization under Yacht Solutions brand; and Seanapps, an application and hardware that receive real time alerts, maintenance recommendations, and boat's information remotely. Bénéteau S.A. was founded in 1884 and is headquartered in Saint-Gilles-Croix-de-Vie, France. Bénéteau S.A. operates as a subsidiary of BERI 21 S.A.
profile.summary_fr: Bénéteau S.A. conçoit, produit et commercialise des bateaux de plaisance en France, dans le reste de l’Europe, en Amérique du Nord, en Amérique du Sud, en Asie et à l’international. Il fournit des bateaux sous les marques Beneteau, Jeanneau, Lagoon, Prestige, Four Winns, Scarab, WellCraft, EXCESS et Delphia. La société propose également Band of Boats, une plate-forme de services communautaires pour l'achat et la vente de bateaux; achat de location, crédit, services d'assurance et solutions de financement des stocks et de détail par le biais de SGB Finance; Dream Yacht Charter, offre une grande flotte de bateaux et un consultant en courtage de yachts; Your Boat Club, un système de réservation en ligne; et WIZIBOAT, une application mobile offre un abonnement pour la voile.
